text:
Deleting your account cancels your Plant Club subscription, but deletion can take up to 30 days to complete. You can start it under "Account" > "Privacy", and you can download your data there first if you'd like a copy.

Because of that delay, I'd cancel the subscription yourself first under "Account" > "Subscriptions". A cancellation made before the 25th applies to the next box, so you won't be charged on the 25th for November's box. There's no cancellation fee. Any box that has already been billed is not refunded and will still be sent.
